assertions.quote: Ben is more than 5 years older than Ann

departures.detail: The words give 34; the assertion has 43.

rules: Each assertion's comment quotes words that are in the problem, ignoring case and spacing.
The numbers in the quoted words, as digits or as words up to twelve, are the numbers in the assertion.
Where the quoted words name a comparison (above, at least, younger than…), the assertion makes that comparison, read with the symbol on the left.
Every sentence of the problem is quoted by some assertion.
data.limitations: The checks read words, not meaning. They do not check which side of a comparison each symbol is on, negation in the words, or units, so a wrong formula can pass. An equivalent rewriting, such as x > 17 for at least 18, is flagged. The quotes are the model's own claim about what each assertion encodes.
